system.description:
Also at 4th level, your dedication to training mind and body yields powerful results. You may ignore difficult terrain penalties to speed during overland travel. You may also choose whether to gain a physical or mystical scouting benefit from the following options:

Physical: You gain proficiency in Stealth and either Acrobatics or Athletics. If you are already proficient in any of these skills, you instead gain expertise in the skill you would otherwise gain. In addition, when you engage in a forced march, you may ignore a number of hours of travel equal to your constitution modifier before you begin making Constitution saves to avoid fatigue.

Mystical: You create a tiny magical sensor which is invisible and has a fly speed of 30ft and the ability to hover. This sensor is created as an action in your space and moves on your initiative count. Each round, you use your movement to move the sensor 30ft. While in effect, you perceive the world through both the sensor and your normal senses, which grants you disadvantage on all attack rolls. This sensor can move up to 120ft away from you and pass through up to 5ft of loose earth, 1ft of wood, 6 inches of stone, but is stopped by an inch of lead. This ability lasts up to 10 minutes and requires concentration to maintain. Once you have used your sensor you may not do so, again, until you’ve taken a short rest. Dispel Magic destroys the sensor instantly.
